title: YASREF 延布煉油廠
summary: YASREF 是延布的煉油設施；本課以原料品質變化、產品收率與海運出貨節奏建立教學情境。本課依序分析原料成分質量混合、產品收率與量綱、品質變動下氫需求、海運批次庫存、交接計量與時間窗，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: YASREF is a Yanbu refinery; scenarios examine feed-quality variation, product yields and marine export cadence. The course analyses mass blending of feed constituents, product yield and dimensional basis, hydrogen demand with quality variation, inventory for marine batches, custody metering and time windows, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 原料成分質量混合、產品收率與量綱、品質變動下氫需求
v31FocusEn: Mass blending of feed constituents; Product yield and dimensional basis; Hydrogen demand with quality variation

options: 質量加權平均適用於某些守恆成分，例如硫元素質量分率；不能無條件套用到黏度、辛烷值或閃點。

steps.title: 原料成分質量混合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mass blending of feed constituents: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「原料成分質量混合」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Mass blending of feed constituents” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：c = (m1 c1+m2 c2)/(m1+m2)；代入 m1 = 700 tonne、c1 = 1.2 mass % constituent、m2 = 322.5 tonne、c2 = 0.2 mass % constituent，得 0.885 mass %（「原料成分質量混合」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 m1 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: c = (m1 c1+m2 c2)/(m1+m2); with m1 = 700 tonne, c1 = 1.2 mass % constituent, m2 = 322.5 tonne, c2 = 0.2 mass % constituent the result is 0.885 mass % (simplified exercise for Mass blending of feed constituents; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise m1 by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：m1 增加 10% 時，結果變為 0.905 mass %（+2.3%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising m1 by 10% changes the result to 0.905 mass % (+2.3%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 0.885 mass %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 m1 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 0.885 mass % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in m1 with an engineering explanation.

Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For “Mass blending of feed constituents”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis.

steps.title: 原料成分質量混合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mass blending of feed constituents: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「原料成分質量混合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mass blending of feed constituents” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「原料成分質量混合」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。用兩批次質量與成分分率計算總成分質量，再除以總質量；核對加權結果位於兩個原始值之間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Mass blending of feed constituents”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Calculate constituent mass in each of two batches, sum and divide by total mass, checking that the weighted result lies between the original values. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 044-01 標記，圖表須寫明「YASREF 延布煉油廠：教學假設」。交付成分質量帳並明示此處只處理守恆成分，其餘品質必須用合適模型與實驗驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 044-01 and mark charts “YASREF Yanbu refinery: teaching assumptions”. Deliver the constituent mass balance and explicitly limit it to a conserved component; other properties require appropriate models and tests.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「原料成分質量混合」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Mass blending of feed constituents” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 原料成分質量混合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mass blending of feed constituents: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「原料成分質量混合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Mass blending of feed constituents” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「原料成分質量混合」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。把體積份額當成質量份額會在密度不同時偏移品質；若採樣未代表整槽，數學平均正確仍不能代表實際出貨。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「YASREF 延布煉油廠」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Mass blending of feed constituents” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first.
